title: The 'Payment' HTTP Authentication Scheme (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01)
quote: This document defines the 'Payment' HTTP authentication scheme, enabling HTTP resources to require a payment challenge to be fulfilled before access.

title: tempoxyz/mpp-specs — Specifications for the Machine Payments Protocol
quote: MPP lets businesses offer services to agents, apps, and humans via a standard HTTP control flow … payment-method agnostic core alongside extensions for specific payment method flows.

title: MPP — Machine Payments Protocol (official site)
quote: MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) is the open standard for machine-to-machine payments via HTTP 402. … an extensible challenge–credential–receipt flow that works with any payment network.

title: Protocol overview — MPP
quote: 402 = Payment barrier (initial challenge or retry needed); 401 = Authentication failure unrelated to payment; 403 = Payment succeeded but access denied by policy.

title: Charge intent for one-time payments — MPP
quote: Payment methods extend this schema with method-specific fields through methodDetails.

title: Subscription intent for recurring payments — MPP
quote: The client authorizes a fixed payment amount once, and the server reuses that authorization to collect at most one charge per billing period. … a subscriptionId alone doesn't grant access.

title: MPP payments — Stripe Documentation
quote: When a client requests a paid resource, your server returns an HTTP 402 response with payment details. The client authorizes the payment, retries the request, pays, and gets access to the paid resource along with a receipt.

title: MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: Charge — A one-time payment that settles immediately. … Session — A streaming payment over a payment channel. … Official implementations exist for TypeScript (mppx), Python (pympp), and Rust (mpp-rs).

title: What Is MPP? The Machine Payments Protocol by Tempo Explained
quote: Agents deposit funds into an escrow contract (roughly 500ms setup time), then issue cumulative EIP-712 signed vouchers with each subsequent request.

title: MPP Session Guide — Stellar Developer Docs
quote: The server closes the channel by submitting one on-chain transaction with the highest cumulative commitment and signature, transferring the total committed amount and returning remainder to the funder.

title: Stripe Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) Explained
quote: Stripe and Tempo's Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) is an open HTTP-native standard for billing AI agents.

title: Machine Payments Protocol: How agents pay for things
quote: The server returns an HTTP 402 with a Challenge in the WWW-Authenticate: Payment header, specifying payment requirements: amount, accepted payment methods, and intent type.

title: Shared Payment Tokens — Stripe Documentation
quote: Shared Payment Tokens (SPTs) let applications initiate a payment without exposing the buyer's payment credentials.

title: mpp-specs methods directory
quote: Method specifications for the Machine Payments Protocol (tempo, stripe, card, solana, stellar, lightning, etc.).

title: Tempo Docs — Accept streamed payments
quote: If the channel balance runs out mid-stream, the server emits a payment-need-voucher event and the client automatically signs a new voucher.
